name: Kavimia – Order Messaging for WooCommerce
author: netanelnati29

sections.description:
Kavimia connects your WooCommerce store directly to the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API. You keep your own Meta account and phone number; no third-party messaging gateway is involved.

Included in the free plugin

  • Direct connection to the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, with a connection test and a guided setup wizard
  • Notifications for order processing, completed and cancelled
  • Automatic creation and status tracking of the WhatsApp message templates (submitted to Meta for approval)
  • Optional customer consent checkbox at checkout (classic checkout and Checkout Block), unchecked by default
  • Message log with masked phone numbers, and a Diagnostics tab you can copy for support
  • Full Hebrew translation and right-to-left (RTL) support
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the WooCommerce Checkout Block

Kavimia Pro (optional, separate paid plan)

Pro is planned to add revenue-recovery automation, such as abandoned cart recovery by WhatsApp. The free plugin is fully functional on its own and has no time limit.

You need a Meta / WhatsApp Business account and pre-approved message templates.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (graph.facebook.com) when a configured WooCommerce notification is sent, and when you press “Test Connection”.

Data sent when a notification is sent: the customer’s phone number, the configured message template name and language, and the template parameters (customer first name, order number, order total).

Data sent on “Test Connection”: your Phone Number ID and access token (as an authorization header) in a read-only request.

This service is provided by Meta Platforms, Inc.

  • Meta Platform Terms: https://developers.facebook.com/terms/
  • WhatsApp Business Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/business-terms/
  • Meta Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

Optional Freemius account and updates

This plugin uses the Freemius SDK to handle optional Pro licensing and updates. On first use an opt-in screen is shown. You can press “Skip” and continue to use every free feature without sharing anything. If you choose “Allow & Continue”, Freemius receives your site URL, WordPress and plugin versions, and your admin name and email, in order to send security and feature updates and to manage licences. Nothing is sent to Freemius before you opt in, other than the checks needed for licensing. Activating a paid Pro licence necessarily sends the licence key and limited site/technical information to Freemius so the licence can be validated and managed, even if you skipped optional usage tracking.

  • Freemius Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
  • Freemius Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Apart from this optional Freemius connection, the plugin sends no data to the plugin author and includes no telemetry.

Privacy

Kavimia Order Messaging processes customer information locally in WordPress and may send configured customer and order data to Meta’s WhatsApp Cloud API when notifications are enabled.

The plugin includes the Freemius SDK for optional usage opt-in, licensing, updates and commercial functionality.

Full privacy policy: https://kavimia.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Kavimia and follow the setup wizard, or open the Connection tab and enter your Phone Number ID, WhatsApp Business account ID and access token.
  3. Create the message templates from the wizard (or the Notifications tab) and wait for Meta to approve them.
  4. Enable the order events you want to notify about.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Meta account?

Yes. You use your own Meta / WhatsApp Business account and phone number. Kavimia does not resell messages and does not use a third-party gateway.

Does the plugin work without registering with Freemius?

Yes. Press “Skip” on the opt-in screen. All free features keep working.

Does it send marketing messages?

No. The free plugin only sends transactional order notifications, and only to customers who gave consent when consent is required.
sections.changelog:
0.4.3

  • Security hardening: settings input is sanitized as soon as it is read, and extensions only receive sanitized values.

0.4.2

  • Fix: when a notification’s template name is left empty, the standard Kavimia template name for that event is used instead of skipping the message.

0.4.1

  • Security hardening: all admin markup is now passed through wp_kses() when output.
  • Removed bundled translation files and development-only files from the package.

0.4.0

  • Prepares the plugin for an optional paid add-on (Kavimia Pro). The free plugin keeps every existing feature and works fully without a licence.
  • Logs and help text now state that “Sent” means the request was accepted by Meta, not that the message was delivered.
  • Internal hooks for extensions; no change to existing settings or data.

0.3.5

  • Plugin header: the plugin URL now differs from the author URL (WordPress.org requirement). No functional change.

0.3.4

  • Readme: added Privacy section and paid-licence disclosure. Added plugin and author URL. No functional change.

0.3.3

  • Renamed the plugin to Kavimia – Order Messaging for WooCommerce (new name, slug and internal prefixes). No functional change.

0.2.5

  • Maintenance: readme metadata update.

0.2.4

  • Improved WordPress.org coding-standard compliance in admin templates (no change in behaviour).

0.2.3

  • Fix: Hebrew right-to-left display of international phone numbers (the plus sign now stays with the number) in the setup wizard help text and the phone number checker.

0.2.2

  • Packaging: rebuilt with the new package folder name.

0.2.0

  • Change: plugin name, slug and text domain are now “Kavimia – Order Messaging for WooCommerce” / kavimia-order-messaging. No change to how messages are sent; WhatsApp is still the delivery channel.

0.1.8

  • Fix: the last setup step now shows the order event names in the site’s language.

0.1.7

  • Improvement: the default checkout consent sentence is now shown in the site’s language (including Hebrew) even if the settings were first saved in another language. A sentence you wrote yourself is never changed.

0.1.6

  • Fix: the very first settings save on a site whose settings row was missing is no longer dropped.

0.1.5

  • Fix: saving settings on a fresh install (when nothing had been changed from the defaults yet) was silently ignored.

0.1.4

  • Privacy: suggested privacy-policy text, WordPress personal-data exporter and eraser (consent and message log), and automatic deletion of log rows older than 180 days (filter: kavimia_om_log_retention_days).
  • Accessibility: the admin header is no longer a nested banner landmark (axe-core scan across all tabs and wizard steps is clean).

0.1.3

  • Plugin Check: escape the exception message in the transport factory.
  • Readme: Freemius disclosure, Pro description, corrected setup path.

0.1.2

  • Fix: activating the Pro build while the Free build is installed no longer causes a fatal error (Free and Pro now switch over cleanly).

0.1.1

  • Freemius SDK integration; uninstall cleanup moved to the after_uninstall hook.

0.1.0

  • Initial development release.
